Redwood person pages by default in 26D

From the 26D update, 6 Oracle Fusion HCM person pages open in Redwood by default, and the older responsive pages are no longer shown by default. You can still go back to a responsive page by setting its profile option to No. Oracle first planned this for 26C and moved it to 26D.

Oracle sources: Oracle 26D What's New: Redwood Enabled by Default for Person Pages · Oracle 26C What's New: Redwood Enabled by Default for Person Pages in Update 26D

Checked against Oracle's pages on 2026-10-19. Oracle can revise its What's New pages; always confirm on the linked Oracle page.

The 6 person pages and their profile options

6 pages, 3 profile option codes. One code, ORA_PER_PERSONAL_INFORMATION_REDWOOD_ENABLED, covers 4 pages (Personal Details, Contact Info, Identification Info and Family and Emergency Contacts), so setting it to No keeps all 4 on the responsive pages. "First delivered" is the update in which Oracle released the Redwood version of the page.

PageProfile option codeRedwood page first delivered
Personal DetailsORA_PER_PERSONAL_INFORMATION_REDWOOD_ENABLED24A
Contact InfoORA_PER_PERSONAL_INFORMATION_REDWOOD_ENABLED24A
Identification InfoORA_PER_PERSONAL_INFORMATION_REDWOOD_ENABLED24A
Family and Emergency ContactsORA_PER_PERSONAL_INFORMATION_REDWOOD_ENABLED24A
Additional Person InfoORA_PER_ADDITIONAL_PERSONAL_INFO_REDWOOD_ENABLED24A
Person Identifiers for External ApplicationsORA_PER_PERSON_IDENTIFIERS_FOR_EXT_APP_REDWOOD_ENABLED23B

How to keep the older pages for now

Oracle lets you switch each page back by setting its profile option to No:

  1. In Setup and Maintenance, open the Manage Administrator Profile Values task.
  2. Search for the profile option code from the table above.
  3. In Profile Values, enter No and save.

Per Oracle, if you set a profile option to Yes in a test pod and then back to No to stay on the older page, that No is kept when the pod moves to 26D. The setting is held separately in each pod, so check production as well as every test pod.

Oracle keeps the full list of HCM Redwood profile options in My Oracle Support: HCM Redwood Pages with Profile Options (Doc ID 2922407.1).

What to check before 26D reaches your test pod

  • Decide, page by page, whether you move to Redwood in 26D or set the profile option to No for now. Because of the shared code, Personal Details, Contact Info, Identification Info and Family and Emergency Contacts move together.
  • Access: per Oracle, the roles that could open the responsive pages can open the Redwood pages too.
  • Custom roles: Oracle points to a 24D change to the privileges for managing addresses on Redwood pages. Check it if you use custom roles.
  • Run the person flows your HR team uses most on the Redwood pages in your test environment.
